Title: Bevacizumab biosimilar candidate TAB008 compared to Avastin® in patients with locally advanced, metastatic EGFR wild-type non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer: a randomized, double-blind, multicenter study
Author: Lu, S.; Qin, S.; Zhou, Z.; et al.
Comment: Medians differ between Abstract (9.10 vs 7.97 months, p=0.9457) and Results/Discussion text (8.97 vs 7.85 months); Results-section values recorded. HR and 95% CI taken verbatim from Results. No p-value is unambiguously attached to the PFS HR in the Results text (p=0.9457 appears attached to DoR there), so p_value left empty.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('TAB008 (bevacizumab biosimilar candidate) + paclitaxel/carboplatin') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomized, double-blind, multicenter phase III equivalence trial
domain: oncology (non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer); biosimilar development
Participant type: Adults 18–75 years, treatment-naïve, EGFR wild-type, stage IIIB–IV non-squamous NSCLC, ECOG PS 0–1
Recruitment source: 53 medical centers in China; enrollment Oct 30, 2017 – Nov 8, 2019 (NCT05427305)
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio (TAB008 biosimilar vs Avastin® reference) from Cox proportional hazards model, with 95% CI; median PFS in months
effect_direction: HR 0.99 (95% CI 0.80-1.22) — essentially no difference, negligibly favoring TAB008 biosimilar

Title: Candidate Bevacizumab Biosimilar CT-P16 versus European Union Reference Bevacizumab in Patients with Metastatic or Recurrent Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Verschraegen et al.
Comment: Medians and HR reported in text; no p-value reported. Confidence interval level for HR stated as 95%. Interim analysis at 1 year of follow-up of ongoing trial.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('CT-P16 (candidate bevacizumab biosimilar) + paclitaxel/carboplatin') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomized controlled trial (double-blind, parallel-group, phase III)
Participant type: Adults with stage IV or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio for PFS, CT-P16 vs EU-bevacizumab, with 95% CI; median PFS in months
effect_direction: HR 0.92 (95% CI 0.77-1.10) — slightly favors CT-P16 biosimilar, not statistically distinguishable

Title: Equivalent efficacy study of QL1101 and bevacizumab on untreated advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer patients: a phase 3 randomized, double-blind clinical trial
Author: Chu T, Lu J, Bi M, et al.
Comment: Chi-square value (1.416) from Mantel-Cox test recorded as test_statistic; no log(HR) or SE reported directly, and no p-value given for overall PFS. Medians recorded without IQR/range because the paper reports none for PFS.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('QL1101 (bevacizumab biosimilar) + paclitaxel/carboplatin') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomized, double-blind, multicenter phase 3 equivalence trial
Participant type: Adults 18–75 years with untreated locally advanced stage IIIb or stage IV non-squamous NSCLC, ECOG 0–1
Recruitment source: 54 clinical centers in China, enrolled Nov 1, 2016 – Jul 31, 2018
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio for progression or death, QL1101 vs reference bevacizumab (median PFS 151 days in both arms)
effect_direction: HR 1.112 (95% CI 0.933-1.326) — slightly favors reference bevacizumab, not statistically distinguishable

Title: Efficacy and Safety of Proposed Bevacizumab Biosimilar BE1040V in Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind, Noninferiority Clinical Trial
Author: Rezvani H, et al.
Comment: HR confidence interval is 90% (not 95%) because of the 1-sided noninferiority design; SE of log(HR) must be derived with z=1.645. Group Ns are randomized Ns (82/44); per-protocol analysed Ns per arm are not stated numerically in the text. Reported 232/210 days are median PFS values.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('BE1040V (proposed bevacizumab biosimilar) 5 mg/kg IV q2w + FOLFIRI-3') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: Adults 18-75 years with histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal cancer, ECOG 0-1
Recruitment source: 22 centers across 9 cities of Iran, October 2016 to July 2018
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio from Cox proportional hazards regression (Kaplan-Meier curves, Figure 2; forest plot, Figure 3)
effect_direction: HR 0.79 (90% CI 0.46-1.35) — favors BE1040V biosimilar, not statistically significant (p=0.47)

Title: A phase III, randomized, double-blind, multicenter study to compare the efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity between SB8 (proposed bevacizumab biosimilar) and reference bevacizumab in patients with metastatic or recurrent nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer
Author: Reck et al.
Comment: Hazard ratio and 95% CI extracted verbatim from the paper's own Cox model; the p-value (0.9338) is reported only in the Abstract. FAS Ns (379 / 383) used as analysed N; the BEV randomized N was 384.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('SB8 (proposed bevacizumab biosimilar) 15 mg/kg + paclitaxel/carboplatin, then SB8 maintenance') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Country: Multinational (100 sites, 13 countries; Germany, Russian Federation, Ukraine, Georgia, Hungary, etc.)
Participant type: Adults (>=18 years) with metastatic or recurrent nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer, ECOG 0-1, no prior first-line systemic therapy
Outcome measurement: Hazard ratio from Cox proportional hazard model with treatment group as explanatory variable (SB8 vs reference bevacizumab); medians in months
effect_direction: HR 0.99 (95% CI 0.83-1.18; p=0.9338) — essentially no difference between SB8 and reference bevacizumab
